name: Valley of Heroes
summary: Stone statues watch over the Valley of Heroes, where Stormwind's southern road crosses the moat into the city. They honor the leaders of the Alliance Expedition to Draenor, and guards hold this fortified entrance.

sections.title: A Monument to the Lost
sections.body: You cross the moat beneath statues honoring the commanders of the Alliance Expedition. Stormwind's rebuilding after the Second War raised these monuments along the causeway. The champions marched through the Dark Portal into Draenor to seal the rift forever, giving their lives so Azeroth might survive. As you head north toward the Trade District, you pass Archmage Khadgar, Kurdran Wildhammer, Ranger-Captain Alleria Windrunner, Force Commander Danath Trollbane, and High General Turalyon.

sections.title: The City Bastion
sections.body: General Marcus Jonathan watches Stormwind's gates from horseback, overseeing the guards and the traffic in and out. The valley is the city's main defense against an overland invasion. Major Mattingly, Field Marshal Stonebridge, and rows of seasoned guards keep watch beside him, guarding the capital from threats beyond its walls.

faq.q: Who are the statues lining the path?
faq.answer: The five statues honor the commanders of the Sons of Lothar who led the Alliance Expedition to Draenor: High General Turalyon, Ranger-Captain Alleria Windrunner, Archmage Khadgar, Kurdran Wildhammer, and Force Commander Danath Trollbane.

faq.q: Why were these monuments placed at the city gate?
faq.answer: Stormwind raised the statues during its restoration after the Second War to honor heroes believed lost in Draenor's destruction. They remind those entering the city of the price paid to keep the kingdom safe.

faq.q: Who commands the guards stationed at the entrance?
aliases: who is the guy on the horse
faq.answer: General Marcus Jonathan commands the Stormwind City Guard and oversees security at the entrance. Major Mattingly and Field Marshal Stonebridge support him.

faq.q: Where does the Valley of Heroes lead?
faq.answer: The bridge leads north into Stormwind City's Trade District. South through the gates, the road enters Elwynn's forests.

angles.text: As a citizen of the Grand Alliance, you can honor the human, high elven, and dwarven martyrs remembered together in the valley.
As a paladin, you can look to the statue of General Turalyon, one of the original champions of the Knights of the Silver Hand.
